_about: Maksim Gorky. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Autobiography; Reminiscences of Tolstoy, Chekhov, and Andreev. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

gorky-reminiscences-leonid-andreyev.bloom_title: Reminiscences of Tolstoy, Chekhov, and Andreev
gorky-reminiscences-leonid-andreyev.evidence: djvu head read: "This translation, which is authorised by Maxim Gorki, was made by Katherine Mansfield and S. S. Koteliansky during the last stay of the former in England, August-September, 1922. This edition is limited to [?] copies." Digital Library of India.
gorky-reminiscences-leonid-andreyev.case: Bloom lists the three memoirs (gathered as one book only in 1934). We already hold the Tolstoy (1920) and Chekhov (1921) Koteliansky-Woolf translations; the Andreyev piece in the Mansfield-Koteliansky limited edition completes the PD set.
gorky-reminiscences-leonid-andreyev.note: The DLI scan's OCR is poor in places (needs re-OCR or proofing) and its imprint year was not readable; the limited edition is said to be 1928, which would still be PD -- confirm on the scan images.

gorky-my-childhood.year: "Copyright, 1915, by The Century Co. Published, October, 1915" (verso); title page New York, The Century Co., 1916
gorky-my-childhood.evidence: djvu head read: "My Childhood by Maxim Gorky, New York, The Century Co. 1916 / Copyright, 1915 ... Published, October, 1915". Trent, internetarchivebooks, no lending flag.
gorky-my-childhood.case: Bloom lists the Autobiography (the trilogy My Childhood, In the World, My Universities); all three parts have pre-1931 American translations.
gorky-my-childhood.note: VERIFY My University Days before acquiring: the Boni scan shows no date or translator in OCR; the translation first appeared 1923 (Boni & Liveright) to my knowledge, and this Albert & Charles Boni issue must be confirmed as pre-1931 and unrevised. Translator of the 1915 My Childhood is not named in the OCR front matter.

gorky-world.evidence: PG header read: translator Gertrude M. Foakes; title page New York 1917, "Author of My Childhood".
